description: Web-layer triage of one public hostname, the scan the /website page runs: A/AAAA with reverse DNS and ASN, CAA, the HTTPS redirect chain, the TLS certificate (issuer, SANs, expiry, WebPKI trust, TLS version), security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy) and cookie flags, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 advertisement, whether plain http:// redirects to https, mixed content on the homepage, security.txt, any CDN or WAF in front (analysis.edge) and timings. `verdict` is ok, warn or fail, the same verdict the page shows; `grade_reasons` says why. Findings are one per failing or amber check: WEBSITE_TLS_UNREACHABLE, TLS_CERT_UNTRUSTED, TLS_CERT_HOSTNAME_MISMATCH, TLS_CERT_EXPIRED, WEBSITE_HTTPS_UNREACHABLE, HSTS_MISSING, CSP_MISSING, FRAME_PROTECTION_MISSING, NOSNIFF_MISSING, HTTP_NOT_REDIRECTED_TO_HTTPS, MIXED_CONTENT_ACTIVE (error); TLS_CERT_NEAR_EXPIRY, WEBSITE_NO_HTTP2, HSTS_SHORT_MAX_AGE, HSTS_NO_SUBDOMAINS, CSP_UNSAFE_INLINE, REFERRER_POLICY_MISSING, PERMISSIONS_POLICY_MISSING, HTTP_REDIRECT_NOT_HTTPS, MIXED_CONTENT (warn); WEBSITE_CHALLENGED (info: the homepage was a bot challenge, so headers were not graded). A name that resolves to a private or reserved address is refused with the non-retriable INPUT_INVALID error. One call makes about ten HTTPS requests from our server and can take 30 seconds on a slow site, so it has its own rate limit, lower than the other tools: on error -32029 wait retry_after seconds. Results are cached for 60 seconds. Read-only.

domain.description: Hostname to scan, e.g. "example.com" or "www.example.com". No scheme, no path.

name: check_website
